text:
maya: Quick check — I'm going to grab an SLO snapshot for the EU deploy tomorrow at 06:00 UTC. Can folks confirm the dashboards we care about and any extra alerts to include?
kevin: list: p95 latency per-route, 5xx rate, error budget burn, kv-cache miss rate, embed-route p99, streaming tail latency. also heatmap for seq len.
nana: add 'reranker' route 4xx spikes and model-variant fallback rates. recent flakiness there.
deploy-bot: preflight-run triggered by @maya: snapshot_id=snap-20240322-01, collected dashboards: p95-latency, 5xx-rate, kvcache, embed-route, reranker. artifacts: https://grafana.redwood/snap/snap-20240322-01 :white_check_mark:
sre-bot: ALERT (simulated): embed-route p95 shows a 40% jump in the last 30m on eu-west. baseline 120ms -> 170ms. recent deploys? trace sample id: trace-8b3c.
kevin: hm that's odd, was there a small version roll earlier today for quantize-v2?
maya: yeah we rolled quantize-v2.1.4-rc3 to staging at 02:10 UTC. No rollout to EU prod.
nana: can we pull logs for trace-8b3c? simple query: 
```
POST /_search
{ "query": { "term": { "trace.id": "trace-8b3c" } } }
```
kevin: pulled it — looks like a spike in kernel fallback on gpu-node-12 causing extra CPU spikes and longer KV fetches. small tail of 502s but mainly long tails.
maya: given this, i'd prefer we snapshot and then hold traffic shift until we confirm no drift overnight. recommend pinning EU to v2.1.4-rc2 (previous) for the change window.
nana: agree. if we pin, add a release note entry: "EU deploy delayed: quantize-v2 variant pinned to v2.1.4-rc2 pending runtime kernel stability checks"
deploy-bot: note recorded: pin_request by @maya -> target route=eu-embed, pinned_version=v2.1.4-rc2, reason="p95 spike in staging for quantize-v2-rc3". ticket: https://issues.redwood/RED-4219
sre-bot: running smoke check: sampling 2k requests across eu-embed and reranker. current p95 eu-embed=118ms, 5xx=0.08%, kv-cache-miss=2.4%. smoke OK on pinned version.
kevin: ok we have two action items: 1) update release notes and call out pin + change window delay, 2) run kernel regression tests on rc3 overnight and re-evaluate at 04:30 UTC.
maya: i'm updating the release_notes draft now: "2024-03-22 EU deploy: hold traffic shift for quantize-v2 until kernel regression completes. Pinned eu-embed to v2.1.4-rc2. See RED-4219."
nana: also add a short blurb in the changelog for platform-ops slack so SRE/oncall see it during the window.
kevin: i submitted a short runbook snippet to the ticket with the queries we used and the trace id.
maya: final call for now — we will not roll traffic tomorrow morning until 05:00 UTC re-eval. If metrics stable, we'll proceed with controlled 10% ramp. If p95 > 1.25x baseline or 5xx rate > 0.5% we'll abort and roll back.
deploy-bot: deploy window policy note saved to RED-4219: ramp_plan={10,30,60}, abort_criteria={p95>1.25x_baseline, 5xx>0.5%}.
sre-bot: tagging oncall: @kevin, @ana, please ack the HOLD and monitor the overnight tests. I'll post the final snapshot at 04:30 UTC.
kevin: ack.
ana: ack. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks — will close the loop once regression tests done. I'll also add the pin note to the release notes PR.
kevin: small FYI for release notes: include rollback instructions and how to unpin via deploy-bot CLI: `deploy-bot pin remove --route eu-embed --version v2.1.4-rc2` so ops can revert when safe.
maya: good call, adding that.
(END)
